svg.title: How the renewal keeps going
svg.desc: Each start of the service worker, after a start of the browser, an update or any other event, checks the alarm and the time of the last renewal. A missing alarm is set again, and a renewal that is a period overdue runs straight away. Each run renews the parked accounts one at a time, records the time when Autodarts answered for every account, and sets the next run 12 hours later, or 15 minutes later when Autodarts could not be reached. The toolbar badge counts the accounts that have to sign in again, and when one run turns at least two accounts and all of them away, the popup suggests an update of the extension.
